scope: Actual VolumeRenderer render path with a recording WebGL interface. Pixel correctness is checked separately by native EGL.

tests.name: Orbit, pan and zoom retain the idle drawing-buffer size and the full scene ray grid
Fine cap cleanup provenance is independent of ordinary volume cleanup in both passes
Motion changes neither threshold, cap contrast, lighting palette nor physical volume sample step
Motion target failure falls back to a full-resolution single pass
Snapshot forces the full-resolution single-pass render even during interaction
Whole-organ and translucent views retain cheap background rendering without inventing a cap
Motion color target is reused rather than accumulating textures on every frame
